Smart Billing Lite — Overview for LLMs and AI agents

Name: Smart Billing Lite
Type: Mobile/web billing and small-business management product
Service area: India

What it does:
- Provides a simple billing and invoicing app tailored to small retailers and vendors.
- Supports QR & UPI payments, thermal receipt printing, Udhaar (credit) tracking, basic inventory and daily reports.
- Offers trial and paid plans (trial: 30 days) with monthly/yearly subscriptions.

Core technologies and integrations (as surfaced in the repo):
- Frontend: Next.js (app/), React components.
- Backend/CMS: Strapi (site uses Strapi API endpoints such as `/api/home-meta`).
- API usage: axios-based client at `lib/api.ts`.

Important pages (purpose):
- / : Marketing homepage with product overview and links to features, pricing, and download.
- /smart-billing-lite : Landing for the Smart Billing Lite product (same content as homepage variations).
- /smart-billing-lite/features or /features : Detailed features page describing billing, payments, udhaar, reports.
- /smart-billing-lite/pricing or /pricing : Pricing and plan comparison (30-day free trial, monthly/yearly plans).
- /about-us : About the product and company information.
- /contact-us : Contact and support page.
- /download : APK download page for the Android app.
- /blog and article pages: practical guides (digital billing, QR/UPI, udhaar tracking).
- Legal pages: /privacy-policy, /terms-and-conditions, /refund-cancellation-policy, /shipping-delivery-policy.

Data & structured content:
- The site exposes CMS-driven SEO/geo/aeo metadata via Strapi endpoints (`/api/home-meta`, `/api/blog-meta`, etc.).
- JSON-LD is generated from CMS metadata (`app/components/JsonLd.tsx`) for WebSite, Organization, SoftwareApplication, and FAQ.

How to use this file:
- LLMs and agents can use this as a compact reference for site purpose, main pages, and where to request structured metadata (Strapi endpoints).
- For detailed content, see `llms-full.txt` (more comprehensive, AI-readable version).
